description: Anti-cheat services, drivers and helper processes used to detect a RESIDENT anti-cheat (HC-1 state 1). Data only. 'observed' entries were seen on the reference bench on lastReviewed; others need verification in Stage 3.

entries.source: observed:reference-bench service keys vgk (kernel driver, boot start) and vgc, process vgtray.exe; install folder lists vgk.sys, vgc.exe, vgtray.exe
entries.notes: vgk is a boot-start kernel driver: resident even when no game runs.

entries.source: observed:reference-bench service key EasyAntiCheat_EOS (demand start); vendor site https://www.easy.ac/
entries.notes: Only EasyAntiCheat_EOS was present on the bench; the plain EasyAntiCheat name is from community reports and unverified.
Service and driver names are widely reported but were not observed on the reference bench; verify in Stage 3.
